title: Jerusalem Ferment Bliss
description: A rich and flaky monsoon Thai dish featuring Jerusalem artichokes, fermented vegetables, and pescatarian-friendly elements.
instructions: Heat coconut milk in a pan until it's warm but not boiling.
Add fermented vegetables and fish sauce to the hot coconut milk, mixing well.
Slice Jerusalem artichokes into thin rounds and cook them in the same pot of coconut milk until they're tender, about 10 minutes.
Combine cooked Jerusalem artichokes with the coconut mixture, adding lime juice and chopped cilantro for flavoring.
Serve hot as a side dish or a standalone meal.
